name: maximize-github-runner-space
description: Cross-platform GitHub Action for reclaiming hosted-runner disk space

scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && ncc build src/index.ts --out dist --minify --no-source-map-register
scripts.postbuild: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({ appendFileSync, readFileSync }) => { const path = 'dist/index.js'; if (!readFileSync(path, 'utf8').endsWith('\n')) appendFileSync(path, '\n'); })"
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({rmSync}) => { rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.clean:dist: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({rmSync}) => { rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.format: prettier --write action.yml src test package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check action.yml src test package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.json && node --test "build/test/*.test.js"
scripts.check-dist: npm run build && test -f dist/index.js && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist)"
